function: Joint channel estimation and CSI feedback in a RIS-assisted downlink: UE encoder compresses a grouped LS estimate, BS decoder reconstructs the full cascaded channel (pp. 2-3).
system: Downlink, BS ULA M = 16 antennas, single-antenna UE, passive reflecting RIS with N = 64 unit cells, no direct path; frequency band not stated (pp. 2, 4).
method: JDCNet: convolutional encoder at the UE, 8-bit quantization, residual decoder (B = 4 ResBlocks) at the BS; supervised MSE training, Adam, 200 epochs; fine-tuning only mentioned (pp. 3-5).
data_channel: Simulated: 48,000 channel samples from the channel model of [19] (an RIS channel-modeling article); 40,000 train, 4,000 test, 4,000 validation; no 3GPP or measured data (p. 3).
test_conditions: Training and testing on the same simulated distribution over SNR 0-35 dB, N0 = 2 and 4, compression 1/16, 8 quantization bits; no unseen scenario evaluated (pp. 3-5).
baselines: Non-learned: TAVL3 [21] with BM3D-PRGAMP [22] (compressive sensing). Learned: nine pairs of SRNet [4], CNN-based [5], EDSR [6] estimators with CsiNet [11], CLNet [12], DCRNet [13] feedback (p. 4).
metrics: NMSE of the reconstructed channel versus SNR; FLOPs and model size (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Table II: JDCNet needs 13.574 MFLOPs and model size 0.026 M at N0 = 2, 9.470 MFLOPs and 0.031 M at N0 = 4 (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 3: "based on the channel model in [19]"
q2_support: p. 3: "with 40,000 allocated to the training set, 4,000 for testing, and another 4,000 for validation"
q3_support: p. 4: "Table I presents the NMSE performance of non-deep learning methods, while Fig. 3 illustrates the NMSE performance of deep learning methods"
q4_support: p. 5: "Table II compares floating point operations (FLOPs) and model size between our proposed JDCNet and the deep learning-based benchmark methods"
q5_support: p. 3: "We generate 48,000 channel samples for network training"
notes: Area 2: joint channel estimation and CSI feedback; the RIS shapes the cascaded channel but the method does not configure it. q1: [19] is a published RIS channel-modeling article, not 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data; reviewer may confirm. q2: p. 4 says fine-tuning on real data 'can' be done, but no such test is reported. q3: non-learned TAVL3 + BM3D-PRGAMP is in Table I, learned pairs in Fig. 3, both in NMSE. q5: no code or data link.
